function: () => { const cards = document.querySelectorAll('[role="group"][aria-roledescription="slide"]'); return JSON.stringify(Array.from(cards).map((c, i) => { const p = c.querySelector('p'); const h4 = c.querySelector('h4'); return { idx: i, ariaLabel: c.getAttribute('aria-label'), quoteText: p ? p.textContent.substring(0, 50) : null, author: h4 ? h4.textContent : null, h4Count: c.querySelectorAll('h4').length, pCount: c.querySelectorAll('p').length }; })); }
